RCB Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the RCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB) Recruitment 2026 is Project Associate II.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate II post in the RCB Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the RCB Project Associate II post?
faq.answer: The last date for the walk-in interview is 24-09-2026. There is no prior online application process.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate II?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. in life sciences with NET/DBT-JRF/GATE or equivalent, with a minimum of 60% marks and two years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Project Associate II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate II position is 34 years as of 31-09-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month plus 27% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the RCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Project Associate II post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at the Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB) in Faridabad, Haryana (PIN: 121001).
